Hemophilia is a serious bleeding disorder that often goes unnoticed because symptoms are not always visible. Contrary to common myths, the absence of external wounds does not mean there is no internal bleeding. Individuals with hemophilia can experience internal bleeding in joints and muscles, which can lead to severe complications if left untreated.

Raising awareness is crucial for early diagnosis and proper management. Understanding the signs and seeking timely medical care can help prevent long-term damage and improve quality of life.
